newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Halliburton estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Halliburton estimates raised.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Wednesday it raised its estimate for Halliburton Co's fiscal 1997 earnings to $3.30 a share from $3.11 and the 1998 estimate to $4.40 from $3.60.
-- Hanifen said Halliburton's reorganization and restructuring is on track, adding that its domestic pressure pumping business is picking up and has an excellent outlook.
-- Halliburton Energy Development, which grew out of the reorganization, should also contribute significantly to revenue in fiscal 1998, Hanifen said.
-- Halliburton is a diversified energy services company.
-- Its shares were up 2-1/8 Wednesday at 70.
